title: Jen Affleck Breaks Free: The ‘Mormon Wives’ Star on Her Divorce and Finding Herself on the ‘Orange County’ Spinoff
summary: The reality star opens up to THR about why she chose not to film with her husband, Zac Affleck, for the new spinoff series, facing public criticism after she filed for divorce, and how the new show and cast became “a safe place.”
